WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT category_id FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id FROM category c JOIN category_tree t ON c.parent_id = t.category_id )
SELECT * FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 'N' AND is_purchasable = 'Y'
AND category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM category_tree)
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
ORDER BY
created_at DESC,
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.count), 0) FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = product.product_id AND o.order_status IN ('결제완료', '배송중', '배송완료')) DESC,
(SELECT COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) FROM review r WHERE r.product_id = product.product_id) DESC,
base_price DESC, base_price ASC, is_recommended DESC, created_at DESC,
product_id DESC

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT category_id FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id FROM category c JOIN category_tree t ON c.parent_id = t.category_id ) SELECT * FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 'N' AND category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM category_tree) ORDER BY product_id DESC

SELECT rental_price_id AS rentalPriceId, duration, monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, deposit_fee AS depositFee, is_b2b_only AS b2bOnly FROM rental_prices WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY duration
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name, brand, model_name, is_purchasable, base_price, is_rentable, rental_price, stock_quantity, description, image_url) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{brand}, #{modelName}, #{isPurchasable}, #{basePrice}, #{isRentable}, #{rentalPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{description}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, brand = #{brand}, model_name = #{modelName}, is_purchasable = #{isPurchasable}, base_price = #{basePrice}, is_rentable = #{isRentable}, rental_price = #{rentalPrice}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, description = #{description}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
